subject: I discovered your secret date history
preview_text: You've been using SoulPlan for a month. What I found in your history will surprise you.
body_paragraphs: I wasn't going to send this. But I checked your date history, and I have to tell you what I found. You've been using SoulPlan for a month now, and you've already planned 4 dates that would have never happened without it.

Think about that. In just 30 days, you've broken the routine, surprised your partner, and created memories that are already in the books. Most couples I talk to say the same thing: the first month is when everything clicks. You're not stuck in the same old dinner-and-movie trap anymore.

Here's where it gets interesting. The feature that most people skip is the one that's secretly changing your relationship. It's the surprise date planner — where you set it up, and your partner has no idea what's coming. Your history shows you used it twice. That's two moments where you showed you care without them asking.

Open SoulPlan now and check your date history. See the progress you've made. Then plan one more surprise date before the month ends. P.S. The couple who planned 8 dates in their first month just celebrated their anniversary — your history is already halfway there.
